premise.coldViewerWhyCare: A colorful quick reference to distinct essential vitamin functions without exaggerated supplement benefit claims
premise.earlyPayoff: Six vitamins have distinct essential jobs in the body

beats.narration: Six vitamins. Six essential jobs. Here's what they actually do.
beats.visualAction: Rapid orbit of six scientifically labeled capsules into single rotating hub.

beats.narration: Vitamin A helps your eyes detect light and supports your immune system.
beats.visualPurpose: Show retinal light absorption turning into signal.
beats.visualAction: Photon arcs hit iris and become bright flowing optic nerve signals.

beats.narration: B twelve helps keep nerves healthy and supports red blood cell formation.
beats.visualPurpose: Show insulated neural communication then blood cells.
beats.visualAction: Nerve fiber sheath illuminates; circular red blood cells enter and orbit.

beats.narration: Vitamin C is essential for making collagen, a key part of connective tissue.
beats.visualAction: Braided collagen triple helix materializes from growing fibers.

beats.narration: Vitamin D helps your gut absorb calcium, supporting healthy bones.
beats.visualPurpose: Show calcium transported across gut lining to bone.
beats.visualAction: Calcium ions travel through a membrane channel into a trabecular bone structure.

beats.narration: Vitamin E works as an antioxidant, helping protect cell membranes.
beats.visualPurpose: Illustrate lipids inside cell membrane and antioxidant reaction.
beats.visualAction: Microscopic lipid bilayer surrounds living cell; unstable radical is neutralized.

beats.narration: Vitamin K helps activate proteins involved in blood clotting.
beats.visualPurpose: Show activation of clotting proteins and protective seal.
beats.visualAction: Molecular clotting factors lock in and generate a symbolic seal at a micro-wound.

beats.narration: That's what these vitamins do inside your body. It does not mean extra pills give extra benefits.
beats.visualPurpose: Contrast normal physiological roles and unproven extra benefits.
beats.visualAction: Completed six-vitamin network contrasts with unnecessary supplement pile graphic.

beats.narration: Too much of some vitamins can be harmful. And vitamin K can interact with warfarin.
beats.visualPurpose: Convey high-dose caution without alarmist imagery.
beats.visualAction: Dose meter exceeds a safe zone; warfarin / vitamin K warning appears.

beats.narration: These essential roles are documented in the N I H vitamin fact sheets.
beats.visualAction: NIH ODS document tiles fan around the network, six individual sources highlighted.
NIH ODS citations displayed in high-contrast neutral clean panel.

beats.narration: Which vitamin should we explore next? Comment a letter.
beats.visualPurpose: Prompt interaction and loop the rotating six-vitamin wheel into first frame.
beats.visualAction: Selected vitamin zooms outward and the six spokes rotate to the opening configuration.
